sn35.73:1.1: yo hi koci bhikkhave, bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti,
sn35.73:1.2: avusitaṃ tena brahmacariyaṃ, ārakāva so imamhā dhammavinayāti.
sn35.73:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.73:2.3: ahañhi bhante channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmīti.
sn35.73:5.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.73:7.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn35.73:11.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.73:13.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn35.73:15.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, sotasmimpi nibbindati, ghānasmimpi nibbindati, jivhāyapi nibbindati, kāyasmimpi nibbindati, manasmimpi nibbindati.
sn35.73:15.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.73:15.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātīti.
